about: Bodies of the remote turn operations (ADR 0040): lease is POST /leases, renew POST /leases/renew, release POST /leases/release and complete POST /leases/complete. Every body is JSON text in a string. valid: a request (status null) or a response with its HTTP status (200; 204 without a body for release) exactly as the Rust implementation writes it; decoding it and writing it again gives the same bytes. Rust's member order and number spelling are examples, not a rule: another implementation may write other JSON with the same meaning. accepted: an input that decodes to the same meaning as the valid case it names (expected), such as response fields this version does not know, omitted or null optional request fields and other spellings of instants, durations and addresses. invalid: an input refused at stage decode (the typed decoder) or conversion (the check after it, of fields that contradict each other). Decoding does not decide whether a server admits a lease or a report's effects.
